weaknesses: Limited scientific novelty: Core contribution is a more configurable battle simulator (engineering/tools contribution). Experiments lack hypothesis-driven insights: Authors acknowledge results are 'primarily illustrative' and don't yield 'fundamentally new insights.' Narrow environmental scope: Limited to combat scenarios, missing important MARL challenges like communication emergence, resource sharing, task allocation, and hierarchical coordination

weaknesses: Fatal flaw: Paper provides a well-engineered tool without demonstrating why this particular benchmark is necessary or what new MARL research becomes possible with it—experiments confirm known phenomena rather than discovering new insights

Incremental contribution combining existing techniques (GPU acceleration, configurable environments, GUIs) without integration producing novel algorithmic or conceptual advances; Table 1 shows main differences are engineering (CONFIG + GUI vs CODE-LEVEL), not fundamental capability gaps

Design choices (fan-shaped FOV, non-targeted mechanics, three terrain types, reward structure) lack systematic justification; no ablation studies on core design decisions despite claiming to 'significantly augment strategic complexity'

Experiments demonstrate illustrative rather than discovery-driven utility: (1) centralized value learning benefits in disjoint observation scenarios are well-known; (2) sparse-reward exploration is predictably difficult; (3) UED generalization failures on unit specs are diagnosed but left unsolved

Systematic scenario construction deliberately isolating specific MARL challenges (e.g., local-sufficient vs. global information dependency), serving as a methodological contribution

Rigorous value estimation analysis using Monte Carlo ground truth with proper statistical analysis (Figure 5, r=-0.82 correlation), showing centralized learning helps precisely where theoretically expected

weaknesses: Limited novel research insights: experimental findings are confirmatory (MAPPO/IPPO vary with observability structure, centralized critics help with disjoint FOV, UED struggles with high-dimensional spaces) rather than revealing, despite thorough validation of the tool
